findings.highlight: It’s like I got thrown in a washing machine
findings.evidenceJa: とびきりの力技というか
findings.governingReading: it was an extraordinary feat of brute force—like being thrown into a washing machine
findings.explanation: Shirou’s judgment that Rin engineered the day through overwhelming force disappears before the washing-machine comparison.

findings.evidenceJa: 緊張も戸惑いも
findings.governingReading: both my nervousness and bewilderment
findings.explanation: The date washed away two distinct states; mirror moon omits Shirou’s disorientation.

findings.highlight: you really did take me to so many places
findings.evidenceJa: よくもあそこまで振り回してくれたな
findings.governingReading: you certainly dragged me around without mercy
findings.explanation: Shirou’s mock reproach at being forcefully led about becomes a neutral account of visiting places.

findings.evidenceJa: 喉が詰まる
findings.governingReading: my throat catches
findings.explanation: A constricted reaction to Rin’s insight becomes respiratory arrest.

findings.highlight: stuck a knife into my wound
findings.evidenceJa: 深い患部に棘を入れられた
findings.governingReading: a thorn—read as a scalpel—inserted into the deep place—written as the affected part
findings.explanation: Both crossed written/readings and the depth of Rin’s psychological incision are flattened into an ordinary knife wound.

findings.evidenceJa: 二人の顔が強ばる
findings.governingReading: both their faces stiffen
findings.explanation: A shared involuntary reaction becomes unnatural wording suggesting intentionally complex expressions.

findings.evidenceJa: 何か大きなモノを剥がされた建物
findings.governingReading: the building as though some great presence had been stripped from it
findings.explanation: The building’s uncanny loss becomes a subjectless statement and “great” is changed to “important.”

findings.highlight: The boundary field my father set up
findings.evidenceJa: 切嗣が張った結界
findings.governingReading: the bounded field Kiritsugu erected, with his name read as “Dad”
findings.explanation: The exact personal and familial attribution of the house’s protection disappears.

findings.evidenceJa: 押し入った
findings.governingReading: forced their way in
findings.explanation: The intruder’s forcible entry is reduced to neutral arrival.

findings.evidenceJa: 愕然とした後
findings.governingReading: after standing stunned
findings.explanation: A moment of shock becomes a gradual rise in worry.

findings.evidenceJa: ぞぶり、と音がした
findings.governingReading: there is a heavy, wet sound
findings.explanation: The first sensory sign of the corrupted house is generalized out of existence.

findings.highlight: Tohsaka and Saber are running behind me
findings.evidenceJa: 背後には駆けつけてくるセイバーと遠坂の足音
findings.governingReading: Inactive narration: behind me come the footsteps of Saber and Tohsaka racing after me
findings.explanation: mirror moon restores a semicolon-commented Japanese narration sentence that is inactive in the original script.

findings.highlight: I don’t even look at them and head straight to the living room
findings.evidenceJa: それさえ視界に納めず、一心に居間へ向かう
findings.governingReading: Inactive narration: without even bringing them into view, I race single-mindedly for the living room
findings.explanation: mirror moon displays the following semicolon-commented narration sentence as well.

findings.evidenceJa: 意識を失った藤ねえ
findings.governingReading: Fuji-nee unconscious
findings.explanation: mirror moon adds the physically incongruous claim that unconscious Taiga is standing.

findings.highlight: if Saber or Tohsaka attack her
findings.evidenceJa: しかけようとすれば
findings.governingReading: if Saber or Tohsaka so much as tries to make a move
findings.explanation: Caster can act before an attack begins; the English triggers her response only once they attack.

findings.evidenceJa: くすくすと笑う
findings.governingReading: She giggles softly
findings.explanation: Caster’s light, cultivated amusement while blaming Shirou becomes generic laughter.

findings.evidenceJa: 関心があるのはそこの坊や
findings.governingReading: the one who interests me is that boy
findings.explanation: “Concerned with” obscures Caster’s predatory interest and can imply worry or subject matter.

findings.highlight: As if saying she’s not interested in Tohsaka
findings.evidenceJa: 遠坂に関心はない、と言うかのように
findings.governingReading: Inactive narration: as though to say she has no interest in Tohsaka
findings.explanation: mirror moon displays a semicolon-commented Japanese inference that is inactive in the original script.

findings.highlight: doing whatever you like without obeying your Master
findings.evidenceJa: マスターに黙って好き勝手やってる
findings.governingReading: doing whatever you please behind your Master’s back
findings.explanation: Rin accuses Caster of secrecy; the English changes it to direct disobedience.

findings.evidenceJa: 魔術師としては優秀
findings.governingReading: excellent as a magus
findings.explanation: Technical competence is replaced by undefined strength.

findings.evidenceJa: 完成した万能
findings.governingReading: completed versatility
findings.explanation: Caster contrasts a finished all-purpose talent with an incomplete specialized one; the English inflates this into divine omnipotence.

findings.evidenceJa: 魔術師として未熟
findings.governingReading: immature and undeveloped as a magus
findings.explanation: Caster values Shirou’s lack of development and ease of control, not merely nonprofessional status.

findings.evidenceJa: 艶めく冷笑
findings.governingReading: an alluring sneer
findings.explanation: The expression changes from cold derision with seductive polish into pleasant laughter.

findings.evidenceJa: 千人単位でマスターを持っているようなもの
findings.governingReading: like possessing Masters by the thousand
findings.explanation: Caster’s order-of-magnitude boast is narrowed to exactly one thousand.

findings.evidenceJa: 怪物じみた宝具
findings.governingReading: monstrous Noble Phantasm
findings.explanation: Caster’s wary characterization of Saber’s weapon as monster-like becomes praise of its quality.

findings.evidenceJa: ほぼ無尽蔵の供給源
findings.governingReading: an almost inexhaustible source
findings.explanation: A qualified estimate is promoted into absolute infinitude.

findings.highlight: laugh on top of others’ sacrifices
findings.evidenceJa: 誰かの犠牲の上で、なお笑い続ける
findings.governingReading: keep laughing even while standing upon others’ sacrifice
findings.explanation: The English copies the spatial metaphor into a non-English collocation and loses continuation.

findings.evidenceJa: 客観的になりすぎて冷えきった思考
findings.governingReading: thought grown cold through excessive objectivity
findings.explanation: The abnormal cold detachment produced by extreme anger becomes ordinary calmness.

findings.evidenceJa: 交渉は決裂
findings.governingReading: the negotiations have broken down
findings.explanation: A standard description of failed negotiations becomes malformed English with the wrong predicate.

findings.highlight: Taking my stare full of enmity
findings.evidenceJa: 敵意を込めた視線を受けて
findings.governingReading: meeting my hostile stare
findings.explanation: The English produces a malformed participial construction at the transition into Caster’s laughter.

findings.evidenceJa: おかしそうに笑っていた
findings.governingReading: laughs as though genuinely amused
findings.explanation: The unexplained cause remains, but the quality of Caster’s amusement disappears.

findings.evidenceJa: 心にもない事なんて、俺は
findings.governingReading: No throat-clog narration in the original Japanese
findings.explanation: The non-Realta English branch inserts an additional bodily reaction before Shirou’s interrupted thought.

findings.highlight: I didn’t… say anything… against what I believe in
findings.evidenceJa: 心にもない事なんて、俺は
findings.governingReading: Something I did not mean—I—
findings.explanation: Shirou’s thought breaks off without completing its denial; mirror moon supplies the conclusion and changes “not in one’s heart” into opposition to belief.

findings.highlight: proves that you detest the Holy Grail
findings.evidenceJa: 聖杯を憎んでいるのではなくて？
findings.governingReading: does that not mean you hate the Holy Grail?
findings.explanation: Caster’s manipulative question is converted into categorical proof of Shirou’s hatred.

findings.highlight: the nausea that fills me up
findings.evidenceJa: 喉元までせり上がってきた、気色の悪い嘔吐感
findings.governingReading: the sickening urge to vomit rising into my throat
findings.explanation: Direction, bodily location, and revulsion disappear from Shirou’s reaction.

findings.highlight: Everyone has to curse something if their happiness is taken away unreasonably
findings.evidenceJa: 不当に自身の幸福を奪われては恨まずにはいられない
findings.governingReading: Anyone unjustly robbed of happiness cannot help feeling resentment
findings.explanation: The object and emotional logic become an obligation to curse an unspecified thing.

findings.evidenceJa: 殺し合いなんて馬鹿らしい
findings.governingReading: killing one another is absurd
findings.explanation: Caster’s argument rejects mutual slaughter, not combat as an unrestricted category.

findings.highlight: She’s probably not telling a lie. Caster must seriously think so.
findings.evidenceJa: その言葉に、嘘はない。おそらく、キャスターは本気でそう思っている
findings.governingReading: There is no lie in those words; Caster probably believes them sincerely
findings.explanation: mirror moon makes the truthfulness uncertain while making Caster’s sincere belief certain, reversing the source’s two epistemic strengths.

findings.evidenceJa: そのような寧言
findings.governingReading: such honeyed words
findings.explanation: Saber’s specific condemnation of coaxing, deceptive speech becomes a contentless reference to “talk.”

findings.evidenceJa: これが最後よ
findings.governingReading: This is my final offer
findings.explanation: Caster is closing a negotiation with terms, not issuing a warning of punishment.

findings.highlight: I shall give you the Holy Grail
findings.evidenceJa: 聖杯は貴方たちに預ける
findings.governingReading: I will entrust the Holy Grail to the two of you
findings.explanation: The plural beneficiaries, including Saber, become an ambiguous singular “you,” and entrustment becomes outright transfer.

findings.evidenceJa: セイバーは迷っている
findings.governingReading: Saber is wavering
findings.explanation: Her conflict over accepting the offer becomes lack of comprehension.
